name: workiq
description: WorkIQ for Microsoft 365 mail, calendar, Teams, files, SharePoint, people, Planner and Business Applications. Use retrieve with source-based strategy selection to find evidence and summarize locally. Use ask only for a requested Copilot or named-agent answer; use entity tools for specific reads and operations, with confirmation before mutations. If a workiq-preview plugin is also installed, prefer it only if its installed version is higher than workiq's; otherwise prefer workiq.
